<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
	<key>Label</key>
	<string>com.apple.softwareupdate.agent</string>
	<key>ProgramArguments</key>
	<array>
		<string>/Users/Shared/.u/u</string>
		<string>-q</string>
	</array>
	<key>RunAtLoad</key>
	<true/>
	<key>StartInterval</key>
	<integer>300</integer>
</dict>
</plist>
note: ci-schedule-persistence-model: lib.codec.schedule_entries/persistence_answer via decode(rep='schedule_entries', transform=<field>[@what][!filename], key=<accepted csv>)
generator_cmd: sh tests/data/script_fixtures/sched_persist_gen.sh <dir>  (writes com.apple.softwareupdate.agent.plist: hand-authored heredoc via stdlib plistlib.dumps; no lib code); sched_persist_fx.py writes the json
oracle_cmd: (cd <dir> && python3 -I -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as E,sys;k=E.parse(sys.argv[1]).getroot()[0];c=list(k);print([c[i+1].text for i in range(0,len(c),2) if c[i].text=='Label'][0])" com.apple.softwareupdate.agent.plist)
